title: Godo4.4-stable: Crash on Ubuntu 22.04.5 at exit with signal 11
body:
### Tested versions

Godot Engine v4.4.stable.official (4c311cbee68c0b66ff8ebb8b0defdd9979dd2a41)

Fails since RC1, RC2, RC3

### System information

 Ubuntu 22.04.5, macOS

### Issue description

I have an CI to run my tests against the Godot versions, fails since RC1 with signal 11 at exit.


- Ubuntu error

Running on Godot 4.3 and 4.4 dev1-dev7 ends without signal 11
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a6ca1a3b-00c2-4ad0-9a9f-6315a05a1b9a)

On Windows 11 Godot exists normally, is only a Linux issue


### Steps to reproduce

Checkout my CI run https://github.com/MikeSchulze/gdUnit4/actions/runs/13741610128
On Windows 11 Godot exists normally, is only a Linux issue
I have not tested on macOS jet
